days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. this is fine as long as these devices enrich to finish surfing the internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. you can use your newly found time to connect with friends, new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life. the high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. during your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. more importantly, however, don't forget to have fun along the way
